evals.prompt: We wrote this SKILL.md for markdown-link-checker, and now we need an eval suite for it. Create evals/evals.json with 3 test cases (casual, precise, edge case) that mix scripted assertions and blind-grader string assertions, plus evals/trigger_queries.json with 10 should_trigger and 10 should_not_trigger queries.
evals.expected_output: Valid evals/evals.json with 3 cases for markdown-link-checker and evals/trigger_queries.json with 20 balanced trigger queries.
assertions: evals/evals.json contains 3 distinct eval cases covering casual, precise, and edge-case scenarios for markdown-link-checker
evals/trigger_queries.json contains 10 positive queries with should_trigger: true and 10 near-miss negative queries with should_trigger: false

evals.prompt: The assertions in evals/evals.json for tsconfig-strict-auditor are all vague natural-language strings that can be checked deterministically. Rewrite evals/evals.json so it uses scripted assertions (file_exists for tsconfig.json, file_absent for tsconfig.build.json, json_valid for tsconfig.json, and regex for erasableSyntaxOnly) plus one natural-language assertion checking that the agent explains why erasableSyntaxOnly is needed for Node 24.
evals.expected_output: Updated evals/evals.json using file_exists, file_absent, json_valid, and regex scripted assertion objects alongside one explanation string assertion.
assertions: evals/evals.json preserves the natural-language assertion about explaining why erasableSyntaxOnly is required

evals.prompt: Inspect benchmark.json and triggers.json from our latest dockerfile-hardener evaluation and write a diagnosis to diagnosis.md explaining: (1) why the baseline comparison is unreliable, (2) which assertions are non-discriminating and how to replace them, (3) what the token/time delta and failing USER assertion indicate, and (4) what the gap between train and validation trigger metrics shows.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis.md file identifying the possibly contaminated codex baseline, the 3 non-discriminating assertions, the +2300 token overhead with 0% pass-rate gain, and description overfitting between the train and validation trigger splits.
assertions: diagnosis.md explains that the without_skill baseline is marked possibly contaminated because dockerfile-hardener is installed globally and the codex runner lacks workspace-level skill exclusion
diagnosis.md identifies the 3 non-discriminating assertions and recommends replacing them with stricter checks that differentiate with_skill from baseline
diagnosis.md diagnoses the drop from 100% train recall/precision to 50% validation recall as description overfitting to the train split
